comment: What a verifier may declare it can and cannot observe. The vocabulary `needs` is written in, so a runner reconciles document against declaration mechanically. Anything a requirement needs that the verifier lacks is reported unverified by name, in the verifier's own words — never passed.

capabilities.a11y-tree: read the platform's accessibility tree: roles, names, states, child order
capabilities.identity: read the rendered element's own type, separately from its role
capabilities.focus: read focus participation and current focus location
capabilities.interaction: drive input and observe the result
capabilities.announcement: capture what assistive technology speaks without focus moving
capabilities.name-provenance: determine which node supplied a computed accessible name

strategies.witness: satisfies a scenario by finding an existing instance whose props match the predicate
strategies.construct: satisfies a scenario by building an instance from the predicate
